header.title: NASA/POWER Source Native Resolution Daily Data

messages: NOTE: this is a hand-constructed fixture matching NASA POWER's documented daily point API response shape (power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/temporal/daily/) - it was NOT captured from a live API call. This dev sandbox's egress policy blocks power.larc.nasa.gov outright, so the real endpoint could not be reached to capture a genuine sample. See ingestion/nasa_power/README.md 'Data source & ToS' for the exact gap and how to close it.
